processing_model.description: Processing model to use for COF transaction. Refer to the card integration guide for more information on the usage.

merchant_signup_code.description: A pre-defined signup code between the merchant and the acquirer.

current_payment_number.description: The current number of recurring payments.

amount_fixed.description: Set `true` to indicate that recurring charges are of the same amount (often used for subscriptions), and set `false` to indicate variable amount between charges (often used for standing orders with fixed schedule).
